- SDR: the screens now follow the radio plugged in. The spectrum only offers the widths the radio can show (up to 3 MHz on an RTL-SDR) and falls back to the widest one available; the Airspy can use its native rates (10 MHz on an R2, 6 MHz on a Mini); an RTL-SDR, an Airspy or a PlutoSDR is set with its own gain steps instead of the HackRF's LNA and VGA
- SDR: new bias tee switch (antenna power) in the gain settings, for the HackRF, the RTL-SDR and the Airspy
- SDR: with a radio plugged in, the tools list only shows the tools that radio can run (all of them with no radio); the texts no longer say HackRF where any radio is meant
- SDR: detailed lines in the debug log when a radio is found, opened, tuned and started, to track down radios that do not start (RTL-SDR Blog V4). If one does not start, please send the log (Settings, Application, Debug log, Share)
